body.statement: Sanity corollary (already known). When \(\mathcal K_n=\{0\}\), \(J_n(G_n)=0\) and the bounded-Lipschitz distance between the law of \(\sqrt n(\widehat\tau_{n,0}-\tau_n)\) and \(N(0,\Gamma_n(0,0))\) tends to zero, which is the trial-only AIPW approximation in Yang, Li, Wu, and Yang.
body.justification: This is the required standard-case reduction and fixes the centering and covariance normalization.
body.gap: This is Yang, Li, Wu, and Yang's trial-only result and is included solely as a normalization check, not as a novelty claim.
body.consumer: Software tests can compare the multiplier implementation against the familiar trial-only Wald interval.
